physical_blocks.exact_text: Summary of ARV-471 and Anastrozole Compliance and Exposure
Number of Subjects with at Least One Action Taken, n(%)

Note: Compliance is 100*(Total cumulative dose/Total planned dose), accounting for planned dose modifications and interruptions. Compliant Patients are those with compliance >= 80% - <= 120%. Absolute Dose Intensity (mg/week)is (Cumulative Dose (mg))/(Duration of Treatment (week)). Relative Dose Intesity (%) is 100*(Absolute Dose Intensity (mg/week))/(Initial Planned Weekly Dose (mg/week), 1400 mg/week for ARV-471 and 7 mg/week for Anastrozole)).
Date of data extraction: DDMMMYYYY; Date of Creation: DDMMMYYYY.
